subject: Draft: Cobalt Commerce customer spotlight — fact check & quote approval
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cobalt-commerce.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: Cobalt Commerce customer spotlight — fact check & quote approval

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to do a customer spotlight with us. Attached is the first draft of the case write-up (attachment: cobalt_case_draft_v1.docx). We focused the narrative on the production rollout you completed with our Dedicated offering and the observed improvements from Q3–Q4 2026.

Three quick asks so we can finalize:
- Can you confirm the two metrics called out in the opening paragraph (latency improvement and token cost reduction)? We pulled these from the runbook you shared but want direct sign-off.
- We included a 1–2 sentence quote attributed to you. If you prefer different phrasing or want a different speaker, please redline.
- If legal needs to review, please loop them in (we can provide a short release/one-pager for signature).

Target timeline: if we can get redlines/approval within 72 hours, marketing will schedule the story for publication in early February.

Attachment: cobalt_case_draft_v1.docx (draft)

Thanks — appreciate your time.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | (415) 555-0138
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena@cobalt-commerce.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Cobalt Commerce Legal <legal@cobalt-commerce.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Cobalt Commerce customer spotlight — fact check & quote approval

Vivek — thanks for sending this over. Overall looks good; we've passed the draft around internally and a couple of redlines are attached (attachment: cobalt_redlines_v1.docx). High-level items from our side: 

- Metric corrections: the draft lists a 4.2x latency improvement — that was from a peak test. Our production median is ~4.1x. Could we change the language to either "about 4x (median)" or include the median figure specifically?
- Please remove the sentence that references a "35% ARR uplift" — that phrase came from a preliminary projection and legal asked us to take it out until our board signs off.
- The quote attributed to me is fine, but legal wants a tighter wording around our customer name usage. I've cc'd legal for their standard release check.

I'll turn around the marked document today. Please confirm you received the attachments and will update the draft.

Best,
Elena Rossi
VP, Platform Engineering
Cobalt Commerce

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@cobalt-commerce.com>, Cobalt Commerce Legal <legal@cobalt-commerce.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Draft: Cobalt Commerce customer spotlight — fact check & quote approval

Marissa / Connor — forwarding Elena's redlines (see attached cobalt_redlines_v1.docx). Two things I need from you: 

Marissa: can you incorporate the wording change? Elena asked to remove the ARR uplift sentence and to soften the language to use "Cobalt Commerce" per legal's preference. Also please prepare a second version where the metric language reads "about 4x (median latency)" and another variant that cites "4.1x median" so we can see what fits. 

Connor: can you validate the performance numbers quickly? Elena mentioned the production median is ~4.1x; if you can confirm from the Q4 run logs whether median = 4.1x and cost reduction is ~38% vs baseline, we'll use the precise phrasing. If the numbers are uncertain, let's default to the rounded "about 4x" phrasing.

I'll attach a refreshed draft once we have your confirmation. Suggest we try to close this by EOD tomorrow so Elena's team can get the legal sign-off.

Attachment: cobalt_case_v2.docx

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@cobalt-commerce.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft: Cobalt Commerce customer spotlight — fact check & quote approval

Vivek / Marissa — I pulled the telemetry and confirmed the numbers from the production rollout (Q4 2026):
- Median inference latency improved ~4.1x after the KV-caching + batching config rolled live (median over 30-day window).
- Token-level cost (unit inference cost) dropped ~38% compared to the pre-rollout baseline (same workload).

Recommendation for copy: use the phrasing "≈4x median latency improvement and ~38% lower token cost" (the approximation symbol is fine for marketing; if legal prefers words, use "about 4x (median)" and "approximately 38% lower token cost").

Attached: metrics_export_Q4_2026.csv (supporting numbers) — feel free to redact any rows you don't want published.

I'm fine with the marketing edits as long as the final doc stays aligned with these numbers.

Connor O'Brien
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Elena Rossi <elena@cobalt-commerce.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Cobalt Commerce Legal <legal@cobalt-commerce.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 14:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Cobalt Commerce customer spotlight — fact check & quote approval

Vivek / Marissa — thanks for incorporating the changes. The updated draft looks good — I reviewed the "≈4x median latency" phrasing and legal has signed off on the redacted release language. This note serves as our approval to publish the customer spotlight with the revised copy.

I've attached our signed one-page release for your records (attachment: cobalt_release_signed.pdf). Please use the final file "cobalt_case_final_for_approval.docx" for publication and let me know the planned publish date so I can share internally.

Approve.

Best,
Elena Rossi
VP, Platform Engineering
Cobalt Commerce
